text_en: PFOA accumulates in fish muscle, liver, kidney, gills, blood, skin and carcass via the mouth and gills, subsequently causing various toxicities.

quote: The kidneys are important immune organs for fish, PFOA accumulation in the kidney is the main mechanism of immunotoxicity in fish and the elimination of PFOA by trout occurs primarily via the renal route (Consoer et al., 2014).
statement: 肾脏是鱼类重要的免疫器官，PFOA在肾脏中的积累是鱼类免疫毒性的主要机制，且虹鳟对PFOA的消除主要通过肾脏途径进行。
text_zh: 肾脏是鱼类重要的免疫器官，PFOA在肾脏中的积累是鱼类免疫毒性的主要机制，且虹鳟对PFOA的消除主要通过肾脏途径进行。
text_en: The kidney is an important immune organ in fish, the accumulation of PFOA in the kidney is the main mechanism of immunotoxicity in fish, and the elimination of PFOA in rainbow trout occurs mainly through the renal pathway.

quote: PFOA can generally cause oxidative stress by producing reactive oxygen species (ROS) and lipid peroxidation in aquatic organisms and mammals both in vivo or vitro (Liu et al., 2007 ; Eriksen et al., 2010 ; Zhao et al., 2011 ; Hagenaars et al., 2013).
statement: PFOA通常通过在体内或体外产生反应性氧物种（ROS）和脂质过氧化来引起水生生物和哺乳动物的氧化应激。
text_zh: PFOA通常通过在体内或体外产生反应性氧物种（ROS）和脂质过氧化来引起水生生物和哺乳动物的氧化应激。
text_en: PFOA typically causes oxidative stress in aquatic animals and mammals by generating reactive oxygen species (ROS) and lipid peroxidation in vivo or in vitro.

statement: PFOA暴露导致Carassius auratus淋巴细胞中GSH含量和SOD活性显著降低。
text_zh: PFOA暴露导致Carassius auratus淋巴细胞中GSH含量和SOD活性显著降低。
text_en: PFOA exposure significantly decreased GSH content and SOD activity in lymphocytes of Carassius auratus.

quote: This study demonstrated that PFOA had an adverse effect on the cytotoxicity, oxidative stress and the Atg 5, Atg 7, and Beclin 1 genes expression in the C. auratus lymphocytes.
statement: 本研究证明PFOA对鲤淋巴细胞具有细胞毒性、氧化应激以及Atg 5、Atg 7和Beclin 1基因表达的不良影响。
text_zh: 本研究证明PFOA对鲤淋巴细胞具有细胞毒性、氧化应激以及Atg 5、Atg 7和Beclin 1基因表达的不良影响。
text_en: This study demonstrated that PFOA has cytotoxic effects, causes oxidative stress, and adversely affects the expression of Atg 5, Atg 7, and Beclin 1 genes in carp lymphocytes.

quote: A report indicated that Perfluorooctane sulfonate exposure induced autophagy blockade in the liver, an immune organ (Yao et al., 2014).
statement: 有报告指出，全氟辛烷磺酸暴露会在肝脏（一种免疫器官）中诱导自噬阻断。
text_zh: 有报告指出，全氟辛烷磺酸暴露会在肝脏（一种免疫器官）中诱导自噬阻断。
text_en: Reports indicate that perfluorooctane sulfonate exposure induces autophagy blockade in the liver (an immune organ).
outcome: 肝脏免疫功能与自噬机制

quote: Also we firstly revealed the connection between dysregulation of Atg 5, Atg 7, and Beclin 1 mRNA expression and oxidative damage in C. auratus lymphocytes exposed to PFOA.
statement: 作者首次揭示了PFOA暴露下鲤淋巴细胞中Atg 5、Atg 7和Beclin 1 mRNA表达失调与氧化损伤之间的联系。
text_zh: 作者首次揭示了PFOA暴露下鲤淋巴细胞中Atg 5、Atg 7和Beclin 1 mRNA表达失调与氧化损伤之间的联系。
text_en: The authors first revealed the link between dysregulated mRNA expression of Atg 5, Atg 7 and Beclin 1 in carp lymphocytes under PFOA exposure and oxidative damage.
outcome: 自噬相关基因表达与氧化损伤关联

quote: The ROS and MDA contents were increased accompanying an increased exposure concentration of PFOA in this study.
statement: 本研究中，随着PFOA暴露浓度的增加，ROS和MDA含量也随之增加。
text_zh: 本研究中，随着PFOA暴露浓度的增加，ROS和MDA含量也随之增加。
text_en: In this study, ROS and MDA contents increased with increasing PFOA exposure concentration.

quote: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) has been detected in various water bodies and caused harm to aquatic organisms.
statement: 全氟辛酸（PFOA）已在各种水体中被检测到，并对水生生物造成危害。
text_zh: 全氟辛酸（PFOA）已在各种水体中被检测到，并对水生生物造成危害。
text_en: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) has been detected in various water bodies and causes harm to aquatic organisms.

quote: C. auratus lymphocytes growth inhibition rates was increased induced by PFOA.
statement: PFOA诱导了鲫鱼淋巴细胞生长抑制率的增加。
text_zh: PFOA诱导了鲫鱼淋巴细胞生长抑制率的增加。
text_en: PFOA induced an increase in the growth inhibition rate of lymphocytes in crucian carp.

quote: Compared with the control group, the ROS generation and the MDA content were significantly increased in all of the PFOA-treated group.
statement: 与对照组相比，所有PFOA处理组的ROS生成和MDA含量均显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，所有PFOA处理组的ROS生成和MDA含量均显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, ROS generation and MDA content increased significantly in all PFOA treatment groups.

quote: Besides, decreased SOD activity and decrease of GSH activity induced by PFOA further confirmed the occurrence of oxidative stress.
statement: 此外，PFOA诱导的SOD活性降低和GSH活性降低进一步证实了氧化应激的发生。
text_zh: 此外，PFOA诱导的SOD活性降低和GSH活性降低进一步证实了氧化应激的发生。
text_en: In addition, the PFOA-induced decrease in SOD activity and decrease in GSH activity further confirmed the occurrence of oxidative stress.

quote: The ROS levels in lymphocytes exposed to PFOA for 12 h were increased significantly in a dose-dependent pattern.
statement: 暴露于PFOA 12小时后，淋巴细胞中的ROS水平呈剂量依赖性显著增加。
text_zh: 暴露于PFOA 12小时后，淋巴细胞中的ROS水平呈剂量依赖性显著增加。
text_en: After 12 hours of exposure to PFOA, ROS levels in lymphocytes increased significantly in a dose-dependent manner.

quote: The MDA content in lymphocytes was increased by 27.6% (P
statement: 淋巴细胞中的MDA含量增加了27.6%。
text_zh: 淋巴细胞中的MDA含量增加了27.6%。
text_en: MDA content in lymphocytes increased by 27.6%.

quote: SOD activity in lymphocytes was significantly decreased with the increase in the exposure concentration of PFOA.
statement: 随着PFOA暴露浓度的增加，淋巴细胞中的SOD活性显著降低。
text_zh: 随着PFOA暴露浓度的增加，淋巴细胞中的SOD活性显著降低。
text_en: As the PFOA exposure concentration increased, SOD activity in lymphocytes decreased significantly.

quote: When the exposure concentration of PFOA was the lowest (1 μg/L), SOD activity was decreased by approximately 9%.
statement: 当PFOA暴露浓度最低（1 μg/L）时，SOD活性降低了约9%。
text_zh: 当PFOA暴露浓度最低（1 μg/L）时，SOD活性降低了约9%。
text_en: At the lowest PFOA exposure concentration (1 μg/L), SOD activity decreased by about 9%.

quote: At the end of the experimental period, two fish from each tank were caught randomly.
statement: 在实验期结束时，从每个水箱中随机捕获两条鱼。
text_zh: 在实验期结束时，从每个水箱中随机捕获两条鱼。
text_en: At the end of the experimental period, two fish were randomly captured from each tank.

quote: Blood was taken from the caudal vein with 2-mL heparinized syringes (sodium heparin) and centrifuged at 1,160 × g for 15 min at 4°C to separate the plasma.
statement: 使用装有肝素钠的2毫升注射器从尾静脉采血，并在4°C下以1,160 × g离心15分钟以分离血浆。
text_zh: 使用装有肝素钠的2毫升注射器从尾静脉采血，并在4°C下以1,160 × g离心15分钟以分离血浆。

quote: The results showed that crucian carp hepatic concentration of triglycerides increased, and hepatic HSL activity and hepatic cAMP, VLDL and apo B100 contents decreased in trichlorfon-exposure treatments.
statement: 在敌百虫暴露处理中，鲫鱼肝脏甘油三酯浓度增加，而肝脏HSL活性以及cAMP、VLDL和apo B100含量降低。
text_zh: 在敌百虫暴露处理中，鲫鱼肝脏甘油三酯浓度增加，而肝脏HSL活性以及cAMP、VLDL和apo B100含量降低。
text_en: In trichlorfon exposure treatment, triglyceride concentration in the liver of crucian carp increased, while hepatic HSL activity and cAMP, VLDL, and apo B100 levels decreased.

quote: This phenomenon was also demonstrated in a previous study on PFOA in zebrafish liver, where a significant reduction in SOD activity was observed (Liu et al., 2008).
statement: 此前关于斑马鱼肝脏中PFOA的研究也证实了这一现象，观察到SOD活性显著降低。
text_zh: 此前关于斑马鱼肝脏中PFOA的研究也证实了这一现象，观察到SOD活性显著降低。
text_en: Previous studies on PFOA in the liver of zebrafish also confirmed this phenomenon, observing a significant decrease in SOD activity.

quote: we suspect this damage could be recovered after termination of PFOA exposure.
statement: 我们怀疑这种损伤在终止PFOA暴露后可以恢复。
text_zh: 我们怀疑这种损伤在终止PFOA暴露后可以恢复。
text_en: We suspect that this damage can recover after the termination of PFOA exposure.

quote: However, dysfunction under higher doses of PFOA exposure (100 μg/L) because the relative expression of autophagic genes (Atg 7 and Beclin1) presented a trend of down-regulation compared to low concentration treatment group.
statement: 然而，在较高剂量的PFOA暴露（100 μg/L）下出现功能障碍，因为与低浓度处理组相比，自噬基因（Atg 7和Beclin1）的相对表达呈下调趋势。
text_zh: 然而，在较高剂量的PFOA暴露（100 μg/L）下出现功能障碍，因为与低浓度处理组相比，自噬基因（Atg 7和Beclin1）的相对表达呈下调趋势。
text_en: However, dysfunction occurred under higher-dose PFOA exposure (100 μg/L), as the relative expression of autophagy genes (Atg 7 and Beclin1) showed a downward trend compared to the low-concentration treatment group.

quote: Trichlorfon influences hepatic pathways of metabolism and transportation and the ultrastructure of hepatocytes in crucian carp, which results in lipid accumulation in the liver.
statement: 敌百虫影响鲫鱼的肝脏代谢和运输途径以及肝细胞超微结构，导致肝脏脂质积累。
text_zh: 敌百虫影响鲫鱼的肝脏代谢和运输途径以及肝细胞超微结构，导致肝脏脂质积累。
text_en: Trichlorfon affects the liver metabolism and transport pathways as well as the ultrastructure of hepatocytes in crucian carp, leading to lipid accumulation in the liver.

quote: The dosage of trichlorfon used to eradicate ectoparasites varies from 0.1 to 1.0 mg/L in ponds, and the findings of this study show that lipid metabolism disorders can occur in crucian carp as a result of long-term exposure to low concentrations of trichlorfon in residual water.
statement: 池塘中用于杀灭体外寄生虫的敌百虫剂量为0.1至1.0 mg/L，本研究发现长期暴露于残留水中的低浓度敌百虫会导致鲫鱼发生脂质代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 池塘中用于杀灭体外寄生虫的敌百虫剂量为0.1至1.0 mg/L，本研究发现长期暴露于残留水中的低浓度敌百虫会导致鲫鱼发生脂质代谢紊乱。
text_en: The dose of trichlorfon used in ponds to kill external parasites is 0.1 to 1.0 mg/L; this study found that long-term exposure to low concentrations of trichlorfon in residual water causes lipid metabolism disorders in crucian carp.

quote: After treatment with 0.5 mg/L trichlorfon, dilatation of the mitochondrial matrix was observed (Figure 3B).
statement: 在0.5 mg/L敌百虫处理后，观察到线粒体基质扩张。
text_zh: 在0.5 mg/L敌百虫处理后，观察到线粒体基质扩张。
text_en: After treatment with 0.5 mg/L trichlorfon, mitochondrial matrix expansion was observed.

quote: In the 1.0-mg/L trichlorfon treatment, mitochondria were vacuolated and mitochondrial cristae were lost (Figure 3C).
statement: 在1.0 mg/L敌百虫处理中，线粒体出现空泡化且线粒体嵴丢失。
text_zh: 在1.0 mg/L敌百虫处理中，线粒体出现空泡化且线粒体嵴丢失。
text_en: In the treatment with 1.0 mg/L trichlorfon, mitochondria showed vacuolization and loss of cristae.

quote: In the 2.0-mg/L trichlorfon treatment, swollen mitochondria and RER dilatation were present (Figure 3D).
statement: 在2.0 mg/L敌百虫处理中，存在线粒体肿胀和粗面内质网扩张。
text_zh: 在2.0 mg/L敌百虫处理中，存在线粒体肿胀和粗面内质网扩张。
text_en: In the treatment with 2.0 mg/L trichlorfon, mitochondrial swelling and rough endoplasmic reticulum dilation were present.

quote: At 4.0 mg/L trichlorfon, broken mitochondrial membranes, mitochondrial vacuolization, loss of cytoplasm, and pyknotic nuclei were observed (Figure 3E).
statement: 在4.0 mg/L敌百虫浓度下，观察到线粒体膜破裂、线粒体空泡化、细胞质丢失和核固缩。
text_zh: 在4.0 mg/L敌百虫浓度下，观察到线粒体膜破裂、线粒体空泡化、细胞质丢失和核固缩。
text_en: At a concentration of 4.0 mg/L trichlorfon, mitochondrial membrane rupture, mitochondrial vacuolization, cytoplasm loss and nuclear pyknosis were observed.

quote: Fish were fed the designated diet at a ration of 3% wet body mass, twice daily for 30 d (Mattson et al. 1988 ; Shakoori et al. 1996 ; Ibrahim and El-Gamal 2003), and no fish mortality occurred during these exposures.
statement: 鱼按湿体重的3%每日两次喂食指定饲料持续30天，期间无死亡发生。
text_zh: 鱼按湿体重的3%每日两次喂食指定饲料持续30天，期间无死亡发生。
text_en: Fish were fed the specified diet twice daily at 3% of wet body weight for 30 days, with no deaths occurring during this period.

quote: Remaining food was removed after feeding.
statement: 喂食后移除剩余食物。
text_zh: 喂食后移除剩余食物。
text_en: Remove leftover food after feeding.

quote: During the feeding experiment, fish were reared under the following water quality conditions: pH of 7.0–7.4, photoperiod of 14 h dark: 10 h light, total ammonia nitrogen of 0.02–0.04 mg/L, and temperature of 22–24°C.
statement: 喂养实验期间，鱼在以下水质条件下饲养：pH 7.0-7.4，光周期14小时黑暗:10小时光照，总氨氮0.02-0.04 mg/L，温度22-24°C。
text_zh: 喂养实验期间，鱼在以下水质条件下饲养：pH 7.0-7.4，光周期14小时黑暗:10小时光照，总氨氮0.02-0.04 mg/L，温度22-24°C。
text_en: During the feeding experiment, fish were reared under the following water quality conditions: pH 7.0-7.4, photoperiod 14 hours dark:10 hours light, total ammonia nitrogen 0.02-0.04 mg/L, temperature 22-24°C.

quote: In the low trichlorfon concentration (0.5 mg/L), no significant difference in HSL activity was observed compared with the control.
statement: 在低浓度敌百虫（0.5 mg/L）下，与对照组相比未观察到HSL活性的显著差异。
text_zh: 在低浓度敌百虫（0.5 mg/L）下，与对照组相比未观察到HSL活性的显著差异。
text_en: Under low concentration of trichlorfon (0.5 mg/L), no significant difference in HSL activity was observed compared to the control group.

quote: However, the diseases caused by Myxobolus species have been the threat to this important commercial fish and resulted in mass mortality or loss of economic value
statement: 由Myxobolus物种引起的疾病对这种重要的商业鱼类构成威胁，并导致大量死亡或经济价值损失。
text_zh: 由Myxobolus物种引起的疾病对这种重要的商业鱼类构成威胁，并导致大量死亡或经济价值损失。
text_en: Diseases caused by Myxobolus species pose a threat to this important commercial fish and lead to mass mortality or loss of economic value.

quote: In our study, plasma insulin concentration increased in fish from all trichlorfon exposure treatments.
statement: 本研究中，所有敌百虫暴露处理组的鱼血浆胰岛素浓度均升高。
text_zh: 本研究中，所有敌百虫暴露处理组的鱼血浆胰岛素浓度均升高。
text_en: In this study, plasma insulin concentrations in fish were elevated in all trichlorfon exposure treatment groups.

quote: Hepatic triglyceride cannot then be transported from the liver and is accumulated in the liver.
statement: 随后甘油三酯无法从肝脏转运出去并积聚在肝脏中。
text_zh: 随后甘油三酯无法从肝脏转运出去并积聚在肝脏中。
text_en: Subsequently, triglycerides cannot be transported out of the liver and accumulate in the liver.
outcome: 肝脏脂肪变性/脂质积累

quote: In our previous study, trichlorfon induced hepatocyte apoptosis and caused mitochondrial vacuolization and lipid droplet accumulation in the hepatocytes of crucian carp in vitro (Xu et al. 2009).
statement: 在先前的研究中，敌百虫在体外诱导了鲫鱼肝细胞凋亡，并引起线粒体空泡化和肝细胞内脂滴积累。
text_zh: 在先前的研究中，敌百虫在体外诱导了鲫鱼肝细胞凋亡，并引起线粒体空泡化和肝细胞内脂滴积累。
text_en: In previous studies, trichlorfon induced apoptosis in crucian carp hepatocytes in vitro and caused mitochondrial vacuolization and lipid droplet accumulation within hepatocytes.
outcome: 细胞凋亡与超微结构损伤

quote: Mataqueiro et al. (2009) studied that trichlorfon could cause fish (pacu Piaractus mesopotamicus) hepatocyte fusion and loss of normal cellular shape.
statement: Mataqueiro等人(2009)的研究表明，敌百虫可导致鱼类（Piaractus mesopotamicus）肝细胞融合和正常细胞形态丧失。
text_zh: Mataqueiro等人(2009)的研究表明，敌百虫可导致鱼类（Piaractus mesopotamicus）肝细胞融合和正常细胞形态丧失。
text_en: Research by Mataqueiro et al. (2009) showed that trichlorfon can cause hepatocyte fusion and loss of normal cell morphology in fish (Piaractus mesopotamicus).

quote: Fish were transported to the Laboratory of Fish Diseases at the Huazhong Agricultural University in China and held in aquaria, where they were euthanised with 0.2 mg/ml tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222, Sigma, St Louis, USA) prior to dissection.
statement: 鱼被运送到实验室并在水族箱中饲养，在解剖前使用0.2 mg/ml的三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）进行安乐死。
text_zh: 鱼被运送到实验室并在水族箱中饲养，在解剖前使用0.2 mg/ml的三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）进行安乐死。
text_en: Fish were transported to the laboratory and kept in aquariums, and euthanized with 0.2 mg/ml tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) before dissection.

quote: With trichlorfon concentration increase, there were also necrotic hepatic cells with pycnotic nuclei and decreased cytoplasmatic affinity for eosin, and the liver changes were more severe with the passage of time.
statement: Increasing concentrations of trichlorfon lead to necrotic hepatic cells and more severe liver changes over time.
text_en: Increasing concentrations of trichlorfon lead to necrotic hepatic cells and more severe liver changes over time.

quote: The same lesions were described in the liver of curimbatá Prochilodus lineatus (Rodrigues et al. 2001) exposed to trichlorfon, 0.2 μL/L)
statement: Similar liver lesions were observed in Prochilodus lineatus exposed to 0.2 μL/L trichlorfon.
text_en: Similar liver lesions were observed in Prochilodus lineatus exposed to 0.2 μL/L trichlorfon.

quote: and in Callychthidae (peppered corydoras Corydoras paleatus) (Fanta et al. 2003) exposed to methyl parathion (0.58 μL/L).
statement: Similar liver lesions were observed in Corydoras paleatus exposed to 0.58 μL/L methyl parathion.
text_en: Similar liver lesions were observed in Corydoras paleatus exposed to 0.58 μL/L methyl parathion.

quote: Results indicated that organophosphorus impairs the enzymatic pathways involved in metabolism of carbohydrates, fats, and protein within cytoplasm, mitochondria, and proxisomes.
statement: Organophosphorus compounds impair enzymatic pathways involved in carbohydrate, fat, and protein metabolism.
text_en: Organophosphorus compounds impair enzymatic pathways involved in carbohydrate, fat, and protein metabolism.

quote: P r e v a l e n c e : 10% (n = 20).
statement: 该研究中 Myxobolus oralis 在样本中的感染率为 10%。
text_zh: 该研究中 Myxobolus oralis 在样本中的感染率为 10%。
text_en: In this study, the infection rate of Myxobolus oralis in the samples was 10%.

quote: This study evaluated the toxic effects of the organophosphate pesticide trichlorfon on hepatic lipid accumulation in crucian carp Carassius auratus gibelio .
statement: 本研究评估了有机磷农药敌百虫对鲫鱼肝脏脂质积累的毒性影响。
text_zh: 本研究评估了有机磷农药敌百虫对鲫鱼肝脏脂质积累的毒性影响。
text_en: This study evaluated the toxic effects of the organophosphate pesticide trichlorfon on hepatic lipid accumulation in crucian carp.

quote: Seventy-five fish were divided into five groups (each group in triplicate), and then exposed to 0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, and 4.0 mg/L of trichlorfon and fed with commercial feed for 30 d.
statement: 75条鱼被分为五组（每组三个重复），并暴露于0、0.5、1.0、2.0和4.0 mg/L的敌百虫中，喂食商业饲料30天。
text_zh: 75条鱼被分为五组（每组三个重复），并暴露于0、0.5、1.0、2.0和4.0 mg/L的敌百虫中，喂食商业饲料30天。
text_en: 75 fish were divided into five groups (three replicates per group) and exposed to 0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 and 4.0 mg/L of trichlorfon, fed commercial feed for 30 days.

quote: The concentration-response relationship for plasma and hepatic triglycerides are shown in Figure 1A, B . Plasma triglyceride contents were significantly (P P Figure 1C . Compared with the control, significant (P P > 0.05).
statement: 暴露于敌百虫后，血浆甘油三酯含量与对照组相比有显著变化。
text_zh: 暴露于敌百虫后，血浆甘油三酯含量与对照组相比有显著变化。
text_en: After exposure to trichlorfon, plasma triglyceride content showed a significant change compared with the control group.

quote: Prior to the experiments, the crucian carp (weight, 74.56 ± 0.02 g [mean ± SE] length, 17.03 ± 0.13 cm) were acclimatized to laboratory conditions in glass tanks (0.85 × 0.55 × 0.45 m) for 2 weeks.
statement: 实验前，鲫鱼在玻璃缸中适应实验室条件2周。
text_zh: 实验前，鲫鱼在玻璃缸中适应实验室条件2周。
text_en: Before the experiment, crucian carp were acclimated to laboratory conditions in glass tanks for 2 weeks.

quote: The experimental aquaria were aerated, and chlorine concentrations in the water were measured daily and were below 0.05 mg/L.
statement: 实验水族箱进行曝气，每日测量水中氯浓度且低于0.05 mg/L。
text_zh: 实验水族箱进行曝气，每日测量水中氯浓度且低于0.05 mg/L。
text_en: The experimental aquariums were aerated, and chlorine concentration in the water was measured daily and kept below 0.05 mg/L.

quote: A concentration of 4.0 mg/L was 10% of the concentration lethal to 50% of a test population (LC50) in 96 h for crucian carp.
statement: 4.0 mg/L的浓度相当于鲫鱼96小时半数致死浓度（LC50）的10%。
text_zh: 4.0 mg/L的浓度相当于鲫鱼96小时半数致死浓度（LC50）的10%。
text_en: A concentration of 4.0 mg/L is equivalent to 10% of the 96-hour median lethal concentration (LC50) for crucian carp.

quote:
Myxobo­
lus acanthogobii Hoshina, 1952 that infects the brain of
Japanese amberjack Seriola quinqueradiata Temminck et
Schlegel causing host scoliosis
statement: 棘头粘体虫感染日本鰤鱼的脑部并导致宿主脊柱侧弯。
text_zh: 棘头粘体虫感染日本鰤鱼的脑部并导致宿主脊柱侧弯。
text_en: Myxobolus infection affects the brain of Japanese amberjack and causes scoliosis in the host.

quote: Hepatic VLDL content was markedly (P 0.05) decreased at 2.0 mg/L trichlorfon compared with the control.
statement: 与对照组相比，在2.0 mg/L敌百虫处理下，肝脏VLDL含量显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，在2.0 mg/L敌百虫处理下，肝脏VLDL含量显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, liver VLDL content was significantly reduced under treatment with 2.0 mg/L trichlorfon.

quote: However, with the rapid development of gibel carp industry, the incidence of various diseases is increasing, and consequently results in serious economic loss .
statement: 随着鲫鱼养殖业的快速发展，各种疾病的发病率正在增加，并导致严重的经济损失。
text_zh: 随着鲫鱼养殖业的快速发展，各种疾病的发病率正在增加，并导致严重的经济损失。
text_en: With the rapid development of crucian carp farming, the incidence of various diseases is increasing and causing serious economic losses.

quote: Unfortunately, there are lack of effective drugs and control measures for this disease until now.
statement: 不幸的是，目前仍缺乏针对该疾病的有效药物和控制措施。
text_zh: 不幸的是，目前仍缺乏针对该疾病的有效药物和控制措施。
text_en: Unfortunately, there are still no effective drugs or control measures for this disease.

quote: For gibel carp, it was found that poly I:C could reduce the mortality of CyHV-2 infection, and improve the mRNA expression profiles of immune-related genes in our previous study [7] .
statement: 先前的研究发现，对于银鲫，poly I:C可以降低CyHV-2感染的死亡率，并改善免疫相关基因的mRNA表达谱。
text_zh: 先前的研究发现，对于银鲫，poly I:C可以降低CyHV-2感染的死亡率，并改善免疫相关基因的mRNA表达谱。
text_en: Previous studies have found that, for silver crucian carp, poly I:C can reduce the mortality rate of CyHV-2 infection and improve the mRNA expression profile of immune-related genes.

quote: Functional analysis revealed that the majority of DE miRNAs were enriched in metabolism and immune signal pathways, suggesting that poly I:C could regulate the cellular levels of specific miRNAs involved in metabolism and immune responses in the head kidney of gibel carp, which may increase the capacity of the immune cells to fight against pathogens infection.
statement: 功能分析显示，大多数差异表达miRNA富集在代谢和免疫信号通路中，表明poly I:C可能调节银鲫头肾中参与代谢和免疫反应的特定miRNA的细胞水平，这可能会增加免疫细胞对抗病原体感染的能力。
text_zh: 功能分析显示，大多数差异表达miRNA富集在代谢和免疫信号通路中，表明poly I:C可能调节银鲫头肾中参与代谢和免疫反应的特定miRNA的细胞水平，这可能会增加免疫细胞对抗病原体感染的能力。
text_en: Functional analysis showed that most differentially expressed miRNAs were enriched in metabolic and immune signaling pathways, indicating that poly I:C may regulate the cellular levels of specific miRNAs involved in metabolic and immune responses in the head kidney of gibel carp, which may increase the ability of immune cells to resist pathogen infection.

quote: Protein-sparing effect of dietary lipid in practical diets for blunt snout bream (Megalobrama amblycephala) fingerlings: effects on digestive and metabolic responses.
statement: Dietary lipid has a protein-sparing effect in practical diets for blunt snout bream fingerlings, affecting digestive and metabolic responses.
text_en: Dietary lipid has a protein-sparing effect in practical diets for blunt snout bream fingerlings, affecting digestive and metabolic responses.

quote: Feed optimization in Atlantic cod (Gadus morhua): fat versus protein content in the feed.
statement: Feed optimization in Atlantic cod involves comparing fat versus protein content in the feed.
text_en: Feed optimization in Atlantic cod involves comparing fat versus protein content in the feed.

quote: Bioconcentration of trichlorfon insecticide in pacu (Piaractus mesopotamicus)
statement: Trichlorfon insecticide bioconcentrates in pacu.
text_en: Trichlorfon insecticide bioconcentrates in pacu.

quote: Previously, we found that poly I:C pre-treatment could stimulate the resistance against CyHV-2 infection and enhance the antiviral immune response in gibel carp [7] .
statement: 先前的研究发现，聚肌胞（poly I:C）预处理可以刺激鲫鱼对CyHV-2感染的抵抗力并增强其抗病毒免疫反应。
text_zh: 先前的研究发现，聚肌胞（poly I:C）预处理可以刺激鲫鱼对CyHV-2感染的抵抗力并增强其抗病毒免疫反应。
text_en: Previous studies have found that poly I:C pretreatment can stimulate the resistance of crucian carp to CyHV-2 infection and enhance their antiviral immune response.

quote: The fish were maintained in the 70 cm × 50 cm × 46 cm fiberglass tanks supplied aerated fresh water under a 12 h:12 h light: dark photoperiod.
statement: 鱼被饲养在提供充氧淡水的玻璃钢水箱中，光照周期为12小时明/12小时暗。
text_zh: 鱼被饲养在提供充氧淡水的玻璃钢水箱中，光照周期为12小时明/12小时暗。
text_en: Fish were reared in fiberglass-reinforced plastic tanks supplied with oxygenated freshwater, with a light cycle of 12 hours light/12 hours dark.

quote: The average water temperature was kept at room temperature and the oxygen saturation of the water was approximately 8.2 mg/L.
statement: 平均水温保持在室温，水中氧气饱和度约为8.2 mg/L。
text_zh: 平均水温保持在室温，水中氧气饱和度约为8.2 mg/L。
text_en: The average water temperature was maintained at room temperature, and the oxygen saturation in the water was about 8.2 mg/L.

quote: The fish were fed once daily with commercial diet at the dose of their 2% weight.
statement: 鱼每天喂食一次商业饲料，剂量为其体重的2%。
text_zh: 鱼每天喂食一次商业饲料，剂量为其体重的2%。
text_en: Fish were fed commercial feed once daily at a dose of 2% of their body weight.

quote: At 24 h post-injection (hpi), 5 fish from each group were chosen, anaesthetized with Tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222), and the head kidney tissues were sampled.
statement: 注射后24小时，从每组选取5条鱼，用MS-222麻醉并采集头肾组织。
text_zh: 注射后24小时，从每组选取5条鱼，用MS-222麻醉并采集头肾组织。
text_en: 24 hours after injection, 5 fish from each group were selected, anesthetized with MS-222, and head kidney tissue was collected.

quote: After euthanizing with buffered tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222), one part of the testes from the fish was collected for testicular section preparation, and the other parts were excised for preparation of gonadal cell chromosomes.
statement: 使用缓冲的三卡因甲磺酸酯（MS-222）对鱼进行安乐死，随后采集睾丸组织用于切片制备和染色体准备。
text_zh: 使用缓冲的三卡因甲磺酸酯（MS-222）对鱼进行安乐死，随后采集睾丸组织用于切片制备和染色体准备。
text_en: Fish were euthanized using buffered tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222), followed by collection of testicular tissue for section preparation and chromosome preparation.

quote: The experimenters were certified under a professional training course for laboratory animal practitioners from the Institute of Experimental Animals, Hunan, China. All experiments were approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of Hunan Normal University (Changsha, China).
statement: 实验人员经过专业实验室动物从业者培训认证，且所有实验均经湖南师范大学机构动物护理和使用委员会批准。
text_zh: 实验人员经过专业实验室动物从业者培训认证，且所有实验均经湖南师范大学机构动物护理和使用委员会批准。
text_en: The experimenters were trained and certified as professional laboratory animal practitioners, and all experiments were approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of Hunan Normal University.

quote: 辛硫磷能够改变鲫鱼体内的能量代谢和氨基酸代谢，干扰鲫鱼体内神经递质的传递以及诱导鲫鱼氧化应激等。
statement: 辛硫磷暴露会改变鲫鱼的能量代谢和氨基酸代谢，干扰神经递质传递并诱导氧化应激。
text_zh: 辛硫磷暴露会改变鲫鱼的能量代谢和氨基酸代谢，干扰神经递质传递并诱导氧化应激。
text_en: Phoxim exposure alters energy metabolism and amino acid metabolism in crucian carp, interferes with neurotransmitter transmission, and induces oxidative stress.

quote: by integrating metabolomics and transcriptomics, changes in the liver metabolites of fish under low-temperature stress have been analyzed in various metabolic pathways
statement: 通过整合代谢组学和转录组学，分析了低温胁迫下鱼类肝脏代谢物在各种代谢途径中的变化。
text_zh: 通过整合代谢组学和转录组学，分析了低温胁迫下鱼类肝脏代谢物在各种代谢途径中的变化。
text_en: By integrating metabolomics and transcriptomics, changes in fish liver metabolites across various metabolic pathways under low-temperature stress were analyzed.

quote: 试验表明，辛硫磷能够影响鲫鱼体内的糖类代谢，氨基酸代谢，以及胆碱能代谢
statement: 试验表明辛硫磷能够影响鲫鱼体内的糖类代谢、氨基酸代谢以及胆碱能代谢。
text_zh: 试验表明辛硫磷能够影响鲫鱼体内的糖类代谢、氨基酸代谢以及胆碱能代谢。
text_en: Experiments showed that phoxim can affect carbohydrate metabolism, amino acid metabolism, and cholinergic metabolism in crucian carp.

quote: 辛硫磷组与空白组两组血清样本基本处于９５％置信区间内，辛硫磷组与空白组之间的代谢轮廓有明显的分离趋势，且两组之间存在明显的聚类趋势，说明辛硫磷组与空白组存在明显的代谢差异。
statement: 主成分分析显示辛硫磷处理组与空白对照组的鲫鱼血清代谢轮廓存在明显分离和聚类趋势，表明两者间存在显著的代谢差异。
text_zh: 主成分分析显示辛硫磷处理组与空白对照组的鲫鱼血清代谢轮廓存在明显分离和聚类趋势，表明两者间存在显著的代谢差异。
text_en: Principal component analysis showed that the serum metabolic profiles of crucian carp in the phoxim-treated group and the blank control group exhibited clear separation and clustering trends, indicating significant metabolic differences between them.

quote: Nowadays, poly I:C has been used in maintaining good health and improving disease resistance in fish, making it as a potential immunostimulant and vaccine adjuvant to protect fish from several aquatic virus infection.
statement: poly I:C已被用于维持鱼类健康和提高抗病力，作为潜在的免疫刺激剂和疫苗佐剂以保护鱼类免受多种水生病毒感染。
text_zh: poly I:C已被用于维持鱼类健康和提高抗病力，作为潜在的免疫刺激剂和疫苗佐剂以保护鱼类免受多种水生病毒感染。
text_en: Poly I:C has been used to maintain fish health and improve disease resistance, as a potential immunostimulant and vaccine adjuvant to protect fish against various aquatic viral infections.

quote: For instance, poly I:C injection could substantially reduce the cumulative mortality of sevenband grouper (Epinephelus septemfasciatus) after viral nervous necrosis (VNN) challenge, and the surviving fish were highly protected from re-challenge [6] .
statement: 注射poly I:C可显著降低七带石斑鱼在病毒性神经坏死症攻击后的累积死亡率，且幸存鱼对再次攻击具有高度保护作用。
text_zh: 注射poly I:C可显著降低七带石斑鱼在病毒性神经坏死症攻击后的累积死亡率，且幸存鱼对再次攻击具有高度保护作用。
text_en: Poly I:C injection can significantly reduce the cumulative mortality of seven-banded grouper after challenge with viral nervous necrosis, and surviving fish have high protective effects against re-challenge.

quote: In our earlier study, the efficacy of poly I:C on protecting gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection has been determined, wherein poly I:C treatment decreased the cumulative mortality and induced powerful antiviral immune response [7] .
statement: 早期研究表明，poly I:C处理降低了鲤鲫对CyHV-2感染的累积死亡率并诱导了强大的抗病毒免疫反应。
text_zh: 早期研究表明，poly I:C处理降低了鲤鲫对CyHV-2感染的累积死亡率并诱导了强大的抗病毒免疫反应。
text_en: Early studies showed that poly I:C treatment reduced the cumulative mortality of crucian carp infected with CyHV-2 and induced a strong antiviral immune response.

quote: Besides, increasing evidences have demonstrated that poly I:C can be used as a candidate substance for introducing trained innate immunity, which is a newly proposed concept that innate immune defense stimulation could increase nonspecific resistance to infection by homologous or heterologous pathogens [8] .
statement: 越来越多的证据表明，poly I:C可作为引入训练性先天免疫的候选物质，这种概念认为先天免疫防御刺激可增加对同源或异源病原体感染的非特异性抵抗力。
text_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，poly I:C可作为引入训练性先天免疫的候选物质，这种概念认为先天免疫防御刺激可增加对同源或异源病原体感染的非特异性抵抗力。
text_en: Increasing evidence suggests that poly I:C can serve as a candidate substance for introducing trained innate immunity, a concept positing that stimulation of innate immune defenses can increase non-specific resistance to infection by homologous or heterologous pathogens.

quote: As reported, feeding with poly I:C could induce long-term immune responses against Edwardsiella piscicida infection in turbot (Scophthalmus maximus) [9] .
statement: 据报道，饲喂poly I:C可在大菱鲆中诱导针对爱德华氏菌感染的长期免疫反应。
text_zh: 据报道，饲喂poly I:C可在大菱鲆中诱导针对爱德华氏菌感染的长期免疫反应。
text_en: It is reported that feeding with poly I:C can induce a long-term immune response against Edwardsiella infection in turbot.

quote: Both ponds maintained dissolved oxygen levels >5 mg/L, water temperatures between 19 and 25 °C, and pH values ranging from 7 to 8.5.
statement: 两个池塘均维持溶解氧水平大于5 mg/L，水温在19至25°C之间，pH值范围为7至8.5。
text_zh: 两个池塘均维持溶解氧水平大于5 mg/L，水温在19至25°C之间，pH值范围为7至8.5。
text_en: Both ponds maintained dissolved oxygen levels greater than 5 mg/L, water temperatures between 19 and 25°C, and pH values in the range of 7 to 8.5.

quote: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein using a syringe pre-coated with a small amount of sodium heparin (ACD).
statement: 使用预先涂有少量肝素钠（ACD）的注射器从尾静脉采集血液样本。
text_zh: 使用预先涂有少量肝素钠（ACD）的注射器从尾静脉采集血液样本。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the tail vein using a syringe pre-coated with a small amount of heparin sodium (ACD).

quote: 100 randomly selected, lightly anesthetized fish of each group (WA, RCC, and WCC) were weighed and recorded.
statement: 对每组随机选取的100条鱼进行轻度麻醉后称重并记录。
text_zh: 对每组随机选取的100条鱼进行轻度麻醉后称重并记录。
text_en: 100 fish randomly selected from each group were weighed and recorded after light anesthesia.

quote: All fish were fasted for 24 h prior to measurement to eliminate the effect of feeding on body weight.
statement: 所有鱼在测量前禁食24小时，以消除摄食对体重的影响。
text_zh: 所有鱼在测量前禁食24小时，以消除摄食对体重的影响。
text_en: All fish were fasted for 24 hours before measurement to eliminate the effect of feeding on body weight.
outcome: 生理状态/体重测量准确性

quote: This is in accordance with a previous report, in which several metabolites were accumulated in poly I:C-treated fish [20] .
statement: 这与之前的报告一致，该报告显示在经 poly I:C 处理的鱼中积累了几种代谢物。
text_zh: 这与之前的报告一致，该报告显示在经 poly I:C 处理的鱼中积累了几种代谢物。
text_en: This is consistent with previous reports showing that several metabolites accumulated in fish treated with poly I:C.

quote: It offers an interesting and attractive approach to increase disease resistance for fish culture.
statement: 这为增加水产养殖中的疾病抵抗力提供了一种有趣且有吸引力的方法。
text_zh: 这为增加水产养殖中的疾病抵抗力提供了一种有趣且有吸引力的方法。
text_en: This provides an interesting and attractive approach to increasing disease resistance in aquaculture.

quote: Actually, the potential of poly I:C pre-treatment to induce trained immunity has been confirmed.
statement: 实际上，poly I:C预处理诱导训练性免疫的潜力已被证实。
text_zh: 实际上，poly I:C预处理诱导训练性免疫的潜力已被证实。
text_en: In fact, the potential of poly I:C pretreatment to induce trained immunity has been confirmed.

quote: 辛硫磷作为一种高效、低毒、广谱的有机磷农药，被广泛应用于动物养殖、农作物生产以及水产养殖中。
statement: 辛硫磷作为一种有机磷农药被应用于水产养殖中。
text_zh: 辛硫磷作为一种有机磷农药被应用于水产养殖中。
text_en: Phoxim, an organophosphorus pesticide, is used in aquaculture.

quote: 辛硫磷可以通过诸多途径进入水体中对鱼类产生毒性威胁。
statement: 辛硫磷通过多种途径进入水体并对鱼类构成毒性威胁。
text_zh: 辛硫磷通过多种途径进入水体并对鱼类构成毒性威胁。
text_en: Phoxim enters water bodies through multiple pathways and poses a toxic threat to fish.

quote: 由于没有具体的辛硫磷使用管理规范以及人们缺乏农药安全使用意识，使得辛硫磷污染水体状况变得愈发严重。
statement: 缺乏管理规范和安全意识导致辛硫磷污染水体的情况日益严重。
text_zh: 缺乏管理规范和安全意识导致辛硫磷污染水体的情况日益严重。
text_en: The lack of management regulations and safety awareness has led to increasingly severe contamination of water bodies by phoxim.

quote: 由图３可知，两组鲫鱼血清样本的１ＨＮＭＲ谱图 ＰＬＳＤＡ参数为：犚２犡＝４４．９％，犚２犢＝０．９７４，犙２＝０．９４４，表明所建ＰＬＳＤＡ模型能够很好地解释辛硫磷组与空白组血清样本之间代谢产物存在明显的差异。
statement: 偏最小二乘法判别分析模型参数表明该模型能有效解释辛硫磷组与空白组鲫鱼血清样本间代谢产物的显著差异。
text_zh: 偏最小二乘法判别分析模型参数表明该模型能有效解释辛硫磷组与空白组鲫鱼血清样本间代谢产物的显著差异。
text_en: The parameters of the partial least squares discriminant analysis model indicate that the model can effectively explain the significant differences in metabolites between serum samples from crucian carp in the phoxim group and the blank group.

quote: 与空白组鲫鱼血清相比，辛硫磷组血清中３羟基丁酸酯、葡萄糖及苯丙氨酸含量显著升高，而谷氨酸、丙氨酸、天冬酰胺、组氨酸等氨基酸，乳酸，不饱和脂肪酸，脂质，甘油磷酸胆碱，磷酸胆碱，胆碱，鸟嘌呤核苷，肌苷含量显著下降（犘＜０．０５）。
statement: 与对照组相比，辛硫磷处理导致鲫鱼血清中3-羟基丁酸酯、葡萄糖和苯丙氨酸水平显著升高，而多种氨基酸、乳酸、脂质及其他代谢物水平显著下降。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，辛硫磷处理导致鲫鱼血清中3-羟基丁酸酯、葡萄糖和苯丙氨酸水平显著升高，而多种氨基酸、乳酸、脂质及其他代谢物水平显著下降。
text_en: Compared with the control group, phoxim treatment significantly increased serum levels of 3-hydroxybutyrate, glucose, and phenylalanine in crucian carp, while significantly decreasing levels of multiple amino acids, lactate, lipids, and other metabolites.

quote:
与空白组相比，辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中
苯丙氨酸含量增加，谷氨酰胺、丙氨酸、天冬酰胺、组氨酸
等氨基酸含量下降。
statement: 与对照组相比，辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中苯丙氨酸增加，其他几种氨基酸减少。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中苯丙氨酸增加，其他几种氨基酸减少。
text_en: Compared with the control group, phenylalanine increased in the serum of crucian carp in the phoxim exposure group, while several other amino acids decreased.

quote:
因此，染毒组鲫鱼血清中氨基酸含量变化结果表
明，辛硫磷可能破坏鱼体细胞的膜蛋白，鱼体为了修复这
些膜蛋白损伤，而引起鱼体中氨基酸代谢紊乱。
statement: 作者推断辛硫磷通过破坏细胞膜蛋白并引发修复反应，导致鱼体氨基酸代谢紊乱。
text_zh: 作者推断辛硫磷通过破坏细胞膜蛋白并引发修复反应，导致鱼体氨基酸代谢紊乱。
text_en: The authors inferred that phoxim causes amino acid metabolic disorders in fish by disrupting cell membrane proteins and triggering repair responses.
outcome: 细胞膜完整性与代谢健康

quote:
最后，染毒组血清中谷氨酰胺含量下降表明
辛硫磷可能引起鱼体神经代谢紊乱，具有一定的神经
毒性。
statement: 染毒组血清谷氨酰胺含量下降提示辛硫磷可能引起神经代谢紊乱并具有神经毒性。
text_zh: 染毒组血清谷氨酰胺含量下降提示辛硫磷可能引起神经代谢紊乱并具有神经毒性。
text_en: The decrease in serum glutamine content in the phoxim-exposed group suggests that phoxim may cause neuro-metabolic disorders and has neurotoxicity.

quote:
辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中葡萄糖含量显著
升高，表明辛硫磷能够抑制鲫鱼血清中葡萄糖的糖酵解
途径，增强其糖异生途径，从而引起鲫鱼血清中葡萄糖代
谢紊乱，能量代谢受到影响。
statement: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清葡萄糖显著升高，表明其抑制糖酵解并增强糖异生，引起葡萄糖代谢紊乱和能量代谢受损。
text_zh: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清葡萄糖显著升高，表明其抑制糖酵解并增强糖异生，引起葡萄糖代谢紊乱和能量代谢受损。
text_en: Phoxim exposure caused a significant increase in serum glucose in crucian carp, indicating that it inhibits glycolysis and enhances gluconeogenesis, leading to glucose metabolic disorder and impaired energy metabolism.
outcome: 葡萄糖代谢与能量状态

quote: 利用代谢组学方法研究环境污染物对鱼类的毒性，有利于确定环境污染物对鱼类作用的靶器官及其特异性的差异代谢物，获得环境污染物对鱼类的毒理机制，从而有助于系统地理解环境污染物对鱼类及整个水生环境所造成的危害，为早期预警环境危害提供快速识别的方法。
statement: 代谢组学方法有助于确定污染物靶器官、获取毒理机制并为环境危害提供早期预警。
text_zh: 代谢组学方法有助于确定污染物靶器官、获取毒理机制并为环境危害提供早期预警。
text_en: Metabolomics methods help identify target organs of pollutants, obtain toxicological mechanisms, and provide early warnings for environmental hazards.
outcome: 环境危害预警与毒理机制解析

quote: 试验前实验室驯养２周以使其适应环境，每日定时投喂饲料，试验前１ｄ停止喂食。
statement: 试验前对鲫鱼进行了2周的实验室驯养以适应环境，并实行定时投喂和停食处理。
text_zh: 试验前对鲫鱼进行了2周的实验室驯养以适应环境，并实行定时投喂和停食处理。
text_en: Before the experiment, crucian carp were acclimated in the laboratory for 2 weeks to adapt to the environment, and scheduled feeding and fasting treatments were implemented.

quote: 辛硫磷组鲫鱼在辛硫磷对鲫鱼影响的安全质量浓度０．３３ｍｇ／Ｌ的水环境中生长２周，空白对照组鲫鱼生长在纯净水环境中，在此期间各组鲫鱼进行正常饲养。
statement: 实验组鲫鱼在安全浓度的辛硫磷水环境中生长两周，对照组在纯净水中生长，期间均正常饲养。
text_zh: 实验组鲫鱼在安全浓度的辛硫磷水环境中生长两周，对照组在纯净水中生长，期间均正常饲养。
text_en: The experimental group of crucian carp grew for two weeks in a water environment with a safe concentration of phoxim, while the control group grew in pure water; both groups were raised normally during this period.

quote: Fish were housed in open pools (0.067 ha) with a suitable pH (7.0–8.5), water temperature (22–24 °C), and dissolved oxygen content (5.0–8.0 mg/L) and with adequate food.
statement: 鱼类被饲养在开放池塘中，并维持了特定的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的食物。
text_zh: 鱼类被饲养在开放池塘中，并维持了特定的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的食物。
text_en: Fish were reared in open ponds, with specific pH levels, water temperature, dissolved oxygen content, and adequate food maintained.

quote: The fish used for blood samples were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, United States).
statement: 用于采集血液样本的鱼使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 用于采集血液样本的鱼使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish used for blood sample collection were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222.

quote: ell volume and altered metabolic characteristics, but it may also be accompanied by higher energy maintenance costs and an increased risk of oxidative stress [ 37 ].
statement: 三倍体生长可能伴随更高的能量维持成本和增加的氧化应激风险。
text_zh: 三倍体生长可能伴随更高的能量维持成本和增加的氧化应激风险。
text_en: Triploid growth may be accompanied by higher energy maintenance costs and increased risk of oxidative stress.
counterevidence: 可能增加氧化应激风险

quote: However, since the annual mortality associated with ‘throat-cancer’ has persisted in the fish farms, these control measures have not been effective.
statement: 由于与‘喉癌’相关的年度死亡率在鱼场持续存在，这些控制措施并未有效。
text_zh: 由于与‘喉癌’相关的年度死亡率在鱼场持续存在，这些控制措施并未有效。
text_en: Because the annual mortality rate associated with 'throat cancer' persisted in fish farms, these control measures were not effective.
intervention: Oral administration of several drugs and herbs

quote:
In early July 2009, almost 2⁄3 of
the allogynogenetic silver crucian carp at a fish farm in
Dafeng, Jiangsu, were killed by the ‘throat cancer’
caused by Myxobolus ampullicapsulatus.
statement: 2009年7月初，江苏大丰一家养鱼场近三分之二的异育银鲫被由Myxobolus ampullicapsulatus引起的‘咽喉癌’杀死。
text_zh: 2009年7月初，江苏大丰一家养鱼场近三分之二的异育银鲫被由Myxobolus ampullicapsulatus引起的‘咽喉癌’杀死。

quote: However, since the 1990s, infection with myxosporeans has caused serious losses of local fish stocks.
statement: 自20世纪90年代以来，粘孢子虫感染导致当地鱼类种群严重损失。
text_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，粘孢子虫感染导致当地鱼类种群严重损失。

population.species: 异育银鲫 (allogynogenetic silver crucian carp)

quote: These mortalities occurred annually, typically in the period from July to September.
statement: 这些死亡每年发生，通常集中在7月至9月期间。
text_zh: 这些死亡每年发生，通常集中在7月至9月期间。

population.species: 异育银鲫 (allogynogenetic silver crucian carp)

quote: allogynogenetic silver crucian carp Carassius gibelio (Bloch) pond-cultured at the Nanquan Experimental Station, China, were found to be heavily infected with myxosporeans, which caused mortalities ranging from 33% (13/40) to 90% (36/40) in the cages.
statement: 在池塘养殖的异育银鲫中发现严重感染粘孢子虫，导致网箱内死亡率在33%至90%之间。
text_zh: 在池塘养殖的异育银鲫中发现严重感染粘孢子虫，导致网箱内死亡率在33%至90%之间。
text_en: Severe infection with myxosporeans was found in pond-farmed allogynogenetic gibel carp, resulting in mortality rates between 33% and 90% within cages.

quote: The pharynxes of infected fish were swollen, nodular, and severely damaged.
statement: 受感染鱼的咽部出现肿胀、结节和严重损伤。
text_zh: 受感染鱼的咽部出现肿胀、结节和严重损伤。
text_en: Swelling, nodules and severe damage appeared in the pharynx of infected fish.

quote: This is the first report of M. ampullicapsulatus causing mass mortality of pond-reared C. gibelio.
statement: 这是首次报道泡囊碘泡虫引起池塘养殖异育银鲫的大规模死亡。
text_zh: 这是首次报道泡囊碘泡虫引起池塘养殖异育银鲫的大规模死亡。
text_en: This is the first report of mass mortality in pond-cultivated gibel carp caused by Myxobolus vesicularis.

quote: 而辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中乳酸含量和丙氨酸含量显著降低验证了该结论。
statement: 辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中乳酸和丙氨酸含量显著降低，验证了上述关于葡萄糖代谢途径改变的结论。
text_zh: 辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中乳酸和丙氨酸含量显著降低，验证了上述关于葡萄糖代谢途径改变的结论。
text_en: In the phoxim-exposed group, serum lactate and alanine levels in crucian carp were significantly reduced, verifying the above conclusion regarding changes in glucose metabolic pathways.

quote: 同时，乳酸含量降低表明辛硫磷影响鲫鱼血清中三羧酸循环途径，从而影响鲫鱼血清中的能量代谢。
statement: 乳酸含量降低表明辛硫磷影响了鲫鱼血清中的三羧酸循环途径，进而影响能量代谢。
text_zh: 乳酸含量降低表明辛硫磷影响了鲫鱼血清中的三羧酸循环途径，进而影响能量代谢。
text_en: The decrease in lactic acid content indicates that phoxim affected the tricarboxylic acid cycle pathway in the serum of crucian carp, thereby affecting energy metabolism.

quote: 辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中脂质含量和不饱和脂肪酸含量显著下降，一方面说明辛硫磷能够导致鲫鱼血清中脂类代谢紊乱，从而导致机体免疫功能下降及影响鲫鱼血清中的能量代谢。
statement: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清脂质和不饱和脂肪酸含量显著下降，表明其引起脂类代谢紊乱，进而导致免疫功能下降及影响能量代谢。
text_zh: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清脂质和不饱和脂肪酸含量显著下降，表明其引起脂类代谢紊乱，进而导致免疫功能下降及影响能量代谢。
text_en: Phoxim exposure caused a significant decrease in serum lipid and unsaturated fatty acid content in crucian carp, indicating that it induced lipid metabolism disorders, which in turn led to decreased immune function and affected energy metabolism.

quote: 另一方面，由于辛硫磷是脂溶性化合物，辛硫磷进入鲫鱼后会渗透到机体细胞膜并在细胞膜脂质上聚集，诱导细胞膜上脂质发生过氧化反应，并产生大量的自由基和活性氧，从而损坏机体细胞膜，引起机体氧化损伤。
statement: 辛硫磷作为脂溶性化合物渗透至细胞膜并聚集，诱导脂质过氧化产生自由基和活性氧，从而损坏细胞膜并引起机体氧化损伤。
text_zh: 辛硫磷作为脂溶性化合物渗透至细胞膜并聚集，诱导脂质过氧化产生自由基和活性氧，从而损坏细胞膜并引起机体氧化损伤。
text_en: As a lipophilic compound, phoxim penetrates and accumulates in cell membranes, inducing lipid peroxidation to produce free radicals and reactive oxygen species, thereby damaging cell membranes and causing oxidative damage to the organism.

quote: 辛硫磷对鲫鱼脂质代谢的作用机制同样体现在丁草胺对金鱼的毒作用机制中［１７］。
statement: 辛硫磷对鲫鱼脂质代谢的作用机制与丁草胺对金鱼的毒作用机制相似。
text_zh: 辛硫磷对鲫鱼脂质代谢的作用机制与丁草胺对金鱼的毒作用机制相似。
text_en: The mechanism of action of phoxim on lipid metabolism in crucian carp is similar to the toxic mechanism of butachlor on goldfish.

quote: 辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中胆碱、磷酸胆碱和甘油磷酸胆碱含量显著降低，其原因可能有两方面：①这３种胆碱代谢物过度修复由于脂质代谢产生的大量自由基与活性氧所引起的细胞膜损坏而使其含量显著下降，表明辛硫磷能够损坏鲫鱼机体的细胞膜，引起机体氧化损伤。
statement: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清中胆碱代谢物显著降低，原因之一可能是这些物质被过度用于修复由自由基引起的细胞膜损坏，表明辛硫磷损坏细胞膜并引起氧化损伤。
text_zh: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清中胆碱代谢物显著降低，原因之一可能是这些物质被过度用于修复由自由基引起的细胞膜损坏，表明辛硫磷损坏细胞膜并引起氧化损伤。
text_en: Phoxim exposure caused a significant decrease in choline metabolites in the serum of crucian carp, possibly because these substances were excessively used to repair cell membrane damage caused by free radicals, indicating that phoxim damages cell membranes and causes oxidative damage.

quote: ②这些胆碱代谢物作为乙酰胆碱合成前体物质，其含量降低说明辛硫磷能够干扰鲫鱼体内神经递质的传递，从而对鲫鱼产生神经毒性。
statement: 胆碱代谢物含量降低说明辛硫磷干扰鲫鱼体内神经递质传递，从而产生神经毒性。
text_zh: 胆碱代谢物含量降低说明辛硫磷干扰鲫鱼体内神经递质传递，从而产生神经毒性。
text_en: The decreased content of choline metabolites indicates that phoxim interferes with neurotransmission in crucian carp, thereby producing neurotoxicity.

quote: 辛硫磷染毒组鲫鱼血清中鸟嘌呤核苷酸和次黄嘌呤核苷酸含量显著下降，可能是由于辛硫磷破坏了鲫鱼体内的能量代谢所致。
statement: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清中鸟嘌呤核苷酸和次黄嘌呤核苷酸显著下降，可能是由于辛硫磷破坏了体内能量代谢所致。
text_zh: 辛硫磷染毒导致鲫鱼血清中鸟嘌呤核苷酸和次黄嘌呤核苷酸显著下降，可能是由于辛硫磷破坏了体内能量代谢所致。
text_en: Phoxim exposure caused a significant decrease in guanosine monophosphate and inosine monophosphate in the serum of crucian carp, possibly due to phoxim disrupting energy metabolism in the body.

quote: Dietary inosine monophosphate improved liver health and ﬂesh quality of gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio) via activating AMPK signalling pathway and enhancing the contents of muscle fat and ﬂavour substance.
statement: 饲料中添加肌苷单磷酸通过激活AMPK信号通路并增加肌肉脂肪和风味物质含量，改善了鲫鱼的肝脏健康和肉质。
text_zh: 饲料中添加肌苷单磷酸通过激活AMPK信号通路并增加肌肉脂肪和风味物质含量，改善了鲫鱼的肝脏健康和肉质。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with inosine monophosphate improved liver health and meat quality of crucian carp by activating the AMPK signaling pathway and increasing muscle fat and flavor substance content.

quote: The results provide an effective food supplementation strategy for cultured ﬁsh.
statement: 研究结果为养殖鱼类提供了一种有效的食物补充策略。
text_zh: 研究结果为养殖鱼类提供了一种有效的食物补充策略。
text_en: The research results provide an effective food supplementation strategy for farmed fish.

quote: The results showed that IMP supplementation alleviated hepatic lipid deposition by increasing the AMP/ATP ratio and activating the AMPK signaling pathway then decreased inflammatory cytokine expression levels.
statement: 补充肌苷单磷酸（IMP）通过增加AMP/ATP比值和激活AMPK信号通路，减轻了肝脏脂质沉积并降低了炎症因子表达水平。
text_zh: 补充肌苷单磷酸（IMP）通过增加AMP/ATP比值和激活AMPK信号通路，减轻了肝脏脂质沉积并降低了炎症因子表达水平。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with inosine monophosphate (IMP) alleviated hepatic lipid deposition and reduced the expression levels of inflammatory factors by increasing the AMP/ATP ratio and activating the AMPK signaling pathway.

text_zh: 由于鱼粉价格高且不可持续，养殖鱼类通常喂食高能配方以节省成本。
text_en: Due to the high and unsustainable price of fishmeal, farmed fish are usually fed high-energy formulations to save costs.

quote: However, the long-term consumption of high-energy feed can result in the accumulation of excessive fat deposits in the liver tissues of farmed ﬁsh and cause various liver diseases (Yan et al., 2015).
statement: 长期食用高能饲料会导致养殖鱼肝脏组织中脂肪过度沉积并引起各种肝病。

text_en: Long-term consumption of high-energy feed leads to excessive fat deposition in the liver tissue of farmed fish and causes various liver diseases.

quote: Currently, the problem of fat accumulation in the liver during aquaculture has been reported in many ﬁsh species, including grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) and Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) (Wang et al., 2019; Yu et al., 2021).
statement: 目前，包括草鱼和尼罗罗非鱼在内的许多鱼类在水产养殖期间肝脏脂肪积累的问题已被报道。
text_zh: 目前，包括草鱼和尼罗罗非鱼在内的许多鱼类在水产养殖期间肝脏脂肪积累的问题已被报道。
text_en: Currently, the problem of hepatic lipid accumulation in many fish species, including grass carp and Nile tilapia, during aquaculture has been reported.

quote: Excessive fat deposition leads to clinical symptoms, such as reduced growth performance and feed utilization, decreased disease and environmental stress resistance and reduced meat quality.
statement: 过度的脂肪沉积导致临床症状，如生长性能和饲料利用率降低、抗病和环境应激能力下降以及肉质降低。
text_zh: 过度的脂肪沉积导致临床症状，如生长性能和饲料利用率降低、抗病和环境应激能力下降以及肉质降低。
text_en: Excessive fat deposition leads to clinical symptoms, such as reduced growth performance and feed utilization, decreased disease resistance and environmental stress tolerance, and reduced meat quality.
